documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial performance for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company outlined its strategic priorities for FY2027, focusing on scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing to its revenue mix, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting revenue growth and a strategic shift from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model following the commissioning of its automated facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Management outlined future growth strategies focused on geographic expansion, operational cost optimization, volume growth, and the expansion of the wood coating segment.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA can increase by 200 to 300 basis points with complete plant utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The management expects the company to cross approximately INR110 crores in top line revenue for the year.
guidance.quote:
Prateek Chaudhary: So, you will cross approximately INR110 crores top line?
Tushar Sanghavi: Hoping so, for your good wishes is also there.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing margins are expected to be near about 50% according to production in coming times.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to be equal, with 50% import and 50% manufacturing within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Yes, that is the question which I am looking that you will you may ask some questions like this. Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal. Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects to selectively expand its market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment, encouraged by improving demand trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports by eliminating duties.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Bangladesh is facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliance requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile ink and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources, to expand the product portfolio and enter adjacent categories.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional manufacturing capacity can be expanded by putting up vessels costing near about INR 3 crores to INR 5 crores utilizing vacant facility space.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process with a zero carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility is designed for further expansion without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a bank loan, INR10 crores was funded through IPO for land purchase, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The company's proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing segment EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, while the trading business margins are 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The transition from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model strengthens margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

margins_costs.claim: Reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% following the start of manufacturing for two products.
margins_costs.quote: We are still importing the rest of the products. We are importing wood coating as well. But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months (November and December) after starting manufacturing, capacity utilization was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The total turnover that can be generated from manufacturing at full utilization with the 500-ton capacity is around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital is not expected to become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: The short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.
The moratorium period for the term loan is June 2026.
As of December end, the net worth stood at around INR42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Conference call statements may contain forward-looking statements that are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: This conference call may contain forward-looking statements about the company which are based on beliefs, opinions, and expectations as of today. Actual results may differ. The statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainty.

management_commitments.claim: Scaling manufacturing utilization and increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of the revenue mix are key priorities for FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: New products from R&D trials with non-textile people will be launched within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a fully manufacturing unit by 2030 and try to become a market leader.
management_commitments.quote: See, we will establish fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030. And try to become a market leader by giving sustainable eco-friendly solution to the textile as well as the wood coating industry.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
